summary: Solowin Holdings filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a direct registered offering of 10,300,000 Class A ordinary shares to certain individual investors at $1.20 per share, for gross proceeds of approximately $12.36 million before expenses, under a securities purchase agreement dated November 5, 2026. No placement agent, underwriter or broker is involved and no underwriting discount or fee is payable; no minimum offering amount and no escrow. The offering follows a 1-for-200 share consolidation effected October 29, 2026; Nasdaq closing price was $1.71 on November 4, 2026. This is a routine primary equity capital raise, not a special situation; watch dilution, the lack of escrow, and the extreme post-consolidation price volatility (52-week range $1.71-$938.00 split-adjusted).
